sources.entry: YouTube Transcript: AI Summary & Chat - Chrome extension that shows a YouTube video as a timestamped transcript, with key points and chat about the video. Free AI credits available. #freemium #video

summary.name: YouTube Transcript: AI Summary & Chat
summary.one_liner: A Chrome extension that shows a timestamped transcript beside any YouTube video, with AI summaries and a chat to ask questions about the video.
use_cases: Finding the exact moment a word is said in a video
Asking questions about a video and checking timestamps
Taking notes from tutorials or interviews
Translating a video transcript into another language
summary.what_it_does: The extension opens a full timestamped transcript beside any YouTube watch page that has captions, and lets you search it and click a line to jump to that point in the video. It generates AI summaries in a chosen length and format (short paragraph, key points, or Q&A). A chat feature answers questions based on what was said in the video, with timestamps to check. Transcripts and summaries can be copied into Notion, Obsidian or Google Docs with formatting, or downloaded. The transcript can open in your language when available and be translated into languages YouTube offers.
notable: Clickable, searchable timestamped transcript beside the player
AI summaries and timestamped Q&A chat about the video
Copy or download transcripts into Notion, Obsidian or Google Docs
Runs only on YouTube watch pages; privacy policy states it does not read browsing history
caveats: Summary and chat use AI credits; free credits are available when signing in with Google
Only works on YouTube videos that have captions
Runs only on YouTube watch pages
